# CareerVivid

CareerVivid is an online learning platform for technical skills and job preparation. It offers 12 interactive courses with 203 hands-on lessons covering AI agents, coding interview patterns, and system design; interview preparation guides for 301 companies; and AI resume tailoring that rewrites a resume against a specific job description.

Everything runs in the browser. Lessons are interactive rather than video-based: short readings, animated playgrounds that step through an algorithm or a request flow, quizzes, and runnable code labs.

## Courses

Catalog: https://careervivid.app/learning

### Coding Interview Patterns — free
https://careervivid.app/learning/coding-interview-patterns

20 algorithm patterns across 60 lessons. Visual step-through animations, recognition signals for spotting which pattern a problem needs, and runnable JavaScript code labs. Covers two pointers, sliding window, binary search, trees and graphs, dynamic programming, Union Find, shortest path, and network flow. Intermediate level, roughly 4 hours. Free to open without an account.

### System Design Interview
https://careervivid.app/learning/system-design-interview

85 lessons across 13 modules: interview framework, capacity estimation, APIs and data models, core building blocks, caching and rate limiting, data at scale, async and event processing, reliability and multi-region, real-time systems, feeds/search/analytics, distributed-system deep dives, a senior capstone, and a classic questions arena. Each module reads the principle, watches a request flow under load, chooses between caches, queues, and partitions, draws the architecture, and explains the trade-offs. Advanced level, roughly 12 hours.

### AI Agent Builder Curriculum
https://careervivid.app/learning/ai-agent-curriculum

10 modules and 58 lessons, from LLM foundations to a shipped portfolio project: AI foundations, LLM basics and sampling, prompt engineering, RAG retrieval, agent architecture, multi-agent systems, evaluation and observability, LLM security and guardrails, deployment controls, and portfolio projects. Beginner to advanced, roughly 9 hours. The AI foundations module is free to start.

## Interview Preparation

- Interview Studio: https://careervivid.app/interview-studio
  Mock coding, system design, and behavioural rounds with AI feedback.
- Company interview guides: https://careervivid.app/quest/{company-slug}
  301 companies, including Airbnb, Adobe, Affirm, Akamai, Algolia, Alibaba, Airtable, and 1Password. Every guide page is browsable without an account; running a scored practice stage requires signing in.

## Resume Tailoring

- Resume builder and tailoring: https://careervivid.app/newresume

Paste or import a job description and CareerVivid rewrites the resume against it — surfacing the evidence that matches the role, aligning wording with the posting, and scoring the match before you apply. Output is ATS-friendly, and each application can keep its own tailored version.

## Also Included

- Job recommendations and application tracking
- Portfolio and whiteboard workspace
- Skill progression with XP and levels
- Chrome extension for saving job postings and autofilling applications: https://chromewebstore.google.com/detail/dmigeakdfokehlhigkhadglgoabceoag?utm_source=item-share-cb
- iOS and Android apps: coming soon

## Pricing

- Free: Coding Interview Patterns, the AI foundations module, and all 301 company interview guides.
- CareerVivid Pro: $6/month, unlocking the full course catalog and AI features.
- Details: https://careervivid.app/pricing

## Audience

Students, new graduates, career changers, and working software engineers who want to build real technical skills, prepare for interviews, and tailor a resume in one place.
